mapper.select:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(electricity_kwh), 2) AS total, ROUND(AVG(electricity_kwh), 2) AS average FROM agg_building_daily
stat_date >= #{startDate} AND stat_date <= #{endDate}

SELECT CASE WHEN air_temperature_c < 0 THEN '<0℃' WHEN air_temperature_c < 10 THEN '0-10℃' WHEN air_temperature_c < 20 THEN '10-20℃' WHEN air_temperature_c < 28 THEN '20-28℃' WHEN air_temperature_c < 35 THEN '28-35℃' ELSE '≥35℃' END AS `tempRange`, ROUND(AVG(cop), 3) AS `copAvg`, COUNT(*) AS `hours` FROM fact_energy_hourly
cop IS NOT NULL AND air_temperature_c IS NOT NULL AND stat_year >= YEAR(#{startDate}) AND stat_year <= YEAR(#{endDate}) AND ts >= #{startDate} AND ts < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND building_id IN #{b}
GROUP BY `tempRange` ORDER BY MIN(air_temperature_c)

SELECT CASE WHEN cop < 2.5 THEN '<2.5' WHEN cop < 3.0 THEN '2.5-3.0' WHEN cop < 3.5 THEN '3.0-3.5' WHEN cop < 4.0 THEN '3.5-4.0' WHEN cop < 4.5 THEN '4.0-4.5' ELSE '≥4.5' END AS `range`, COUNT(*) AS `hours` FROM fact_energy_hourly
cop IS NOT NULL AND stat_year >= YEAR(#{startDate}) AND stat_year <= YEAR(#{endDate}) AND ts >= #{startDate} AND ts < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND building_id IN #{b}
GROUP BY `range` ORDER BY MIN(cop)

SELECT building_id AS buildingId, anomaly_type AS anomalyType, COUNT(*) AS hours, ROUND(AVG(electricity_kwh), 1) AS avgKwh, ROUND(MAX(electricity_kwh), 1) AS maxKwh, ROUND(AVG(baseline), 1) AS avgBaseline, ROUND(AVG(zscore), 2) AS avgZscore, ROUND(AVG(air_temperature_c), 1) AS avgTemp, ROUND(AVG(humidity_pct), 1) AS avgHumidity, ROUND(AVG(occupancy_density), 2) AS avgOccupancy, ROUND(AVG(cop), 2) AS avgCop, ROUND(AVG(chw_supply_temp_c), 2) AS avgSupplyTemp, ROUND(AVG(chw_return_temp_c), 2) AS avgReturnTemp, MIN(ts) AS firstSeen, MAX(ts) AS lastSeen FROM fact_energy_hourly
anomaly_flag = 1 AND stat_year >= YEAR(#{startDate}) AND stat_year <= YEAR(#{endDate}) AND ts >= #{startDate} AND ts < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND building_id IN #{b}
GROUP BY building_id, anomaly_type ORDER BY hours DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT f.building_id AS buildingId, MAX(b.building_type_cn) AS buildingTypeCn, MAX(b.area_m2) AS areaM2, MAX(b.data_grade) AS dataGrade, MAX(b.energy_grade) AS energyGrade, MAX(b.eui_kwh_m2_year) AS euiYear, ROUND(SUM(f.electricity_kwh), 1) AS electricityKwh, ROUND(SUM(f.hvac_kwh), 1) AS hvacKwh, ROUND(SUM(f.carbon_kg), 1) AS carbonKg, ROUND(AVG(f.cop), 3) AS copAvg, ROUND(MIN(f.cop), 3) AS copMin, ROUND(AVG(f.chw_supply_temp_c), 2) AS supplyTempAvg, ROUND(AVG(f.chw_return_temp_c), 2) AS returnTempAvg, ROUND(AVG(f.chw_return_temp_c - f.chw_supply_temp_c), 2) AS deltaTAvg, SUM(CASE WHEN f.anomaly_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS anomalyHours, SUM(CASE WHEN f.data_quality_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS qualityHours, COUNT(*) AS evaluatedHours, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN f.stat_hour BETWEEN 10 AND 17 THEN f.electricity_kwh END), 1) AS daytimeAvgKwh, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN f.stat_hour BETWEEN 0 AND 6 THEN f.electricity_kwh END), 1) AS nightAvgKwh FROM fact_energy_hourly f LEFT JOIN dim_building b ON b.building_id = f.building_id
f.stat_year >= YEAR(#{startDate}) AND f.stat_year <= YEAR(#{endDate}) AND f.ts >= #{startDate} AND f.ts < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND f.building_id IN #{b}
GROUP BY f.building_id LIMIT 1

SELECT e.building_id AS buildingId, e.site_id AS siteId, MAX(b.building_type_cn) AS buildingTypeCn, MAX(e.duration_hours) AS maxDurationHours, SUM(e.duration_hours) AS totalDurationHours, COUNT(*) AS eventCount FROM fact_anomaly_event e LEFT JOIN dim_building b ON b.building_id = e.building_id WHERE e.start_ts >= #{startDate} AND e.start_ts < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND e.site_id = #{siteId} GROUP BY e.building_id, e.site_id ORDER BY maxDurationHours DESC LIMIT #{limit}
